text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She brilliantly captures the first crown 
of the Triple Tiara. The spectators were 
sent into a frenzy by her overwhelming 
performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu, too, is intoxicated by the 
heat of the race. The other runners look 
upon her with envious eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the second crown of the Tiara: 
the Yushun Himba (Oaks). Mejiro Ramonu 
seeks a race that will stir her love even 
more deeply.
